req.title: Reject player with duplicate squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 409 Conflict when the squadNumber in a new player already belongs to another player.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should reject a player creation request if the squad number is already in use, returning a 409 Conflict status. This ensures data integrity by preventing duplicate squad numbers. The test suite includes a positive test to verify successful player creation with a unique squad number, a negative test to ensure a 409 Conflict is returned for duplicate squad numbers, and a boundary test to check behavior at the edge of valid squad numbers.

tests.name: test_create_player_unique_squad_number
preconditions: The database is pre-loaded with players having squad numbers 1 to 26.
actions: Send a POST request to create a player with a unique squad number 27.
expected: The response status code is 201 Created.
The response contains the player data with squad number 27.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

new_player = {
    "firstName": "Test",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Player",
    "dateOfBirth": "1990-01-01",
    "squadNumber": 27,
    "position": "Midfielder",
    "abbrPosition": "MF",
    "team": "Test Team",
    "league": "Test League",
    "starting11": False
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=new_player)
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["squadNumber"] == 27

tests.name: test_create_player_duplicate_squad_number
preconditions: The database is pre-loaded with players having squad numbers 1 to 26.
actions: Send a POST request to create a player with an existing squad number 10.
expected: The response status code is 409 Conflict.
The response contains an error message indicating the squad number is already in use.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

duplicate_player = {
    "firstName": "Duplicate",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Player",
    "dateOfBirth": "1990-01-01",
    "squadNumber": 10,
    "position": "Midfielder",
    "abbrPosition": "MF",
    "team": "Test Team",
    "league": "Test League",
    "starting11": False
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=duplicate_player)
assert response.status_code == 409
assert "A Player with this squad number already exists." in response.json()["detail"]

tests.name: test_create_player_boundary_squad_number
preconditions: The database is pre-loaded with players having squad numbers 1 to 26.
actions: Send a POST request to create a player with squad number 0.
expected: The response status code is 422 Unprocessable Entity.
The response contains an error message indicating invalid squad number.
